standing: presentation baseline only — craft continuity, never semantic truth
lineage_chain: O:I global → Epi global → roz-corpus-base → register-mytheme (this file) → family profile → record variant → scene override

register.name: mytheme
register.vak_office: madhyamā — formed visual/narrative operations built through the logic
register.law: whole source/story → complete relational Mytheme → internal/story sequence → derivative occurrence → cross-story relation → Return; never atomised cards

field.params_note: count 62000 carried from corpus base; calmer speed/turbulence than the ink default so a staged story stays legible in captures; richer multi-colour palettes per world family

corpus_baseline_overrides.palette_policy: 2–6 colours per scene, world-family keyed; scene-local palette shifts carry the story's own turn (capture, underworld, whirlwind, banquet) — presentation only, never a claimed source correspondence

scene_grammar.shape_kit: text glyphs for figures, ring/disc for cycles-mouths-wells, square for framed/enclosed things, triangle for arbitration, yantra/cymatic for structured wholes — each shape staged only where the record's own story uses that figure
scene_grammar.sequence_use: multi-step entity sequences where the story itself transforms (egg division, pursuit→tree, box→circle, bonds→release)
scene_grammar.text_layers: title carries the beat; italic line carries the mythemic verb (figures/embodies/demonstrates/proves-discloses); body carries the exact story occurrences; every scene body ends with an indexed occurrence line; cross-story relations named only as the records declare them

rules: a Whole Mytheme Expression must be sequenced enough that its ending can qualify its beginning
derivative figures/things/places/actions/motifs appear only indexed to whole-story occurrences
human-amplified flags carry through bindings verbatim; unratified candidates stay unratified in notes
mythemic verbs only — never formal entailment, never historical attribution
the trick of a still capture: arrangement + text must read whole-arc even before motion is watched
